name: Ren
source:
He has a scholarship in Dr. Marc Rossell’s engineering lab with Tirs, Biel, Quim and Zoe. He’s serious and hard-worker, and he despises people who don’t take their jobs seriously. He definitely doesn’t like social climbers, and can get judgmental and mean with them. He’s the kind of person who prefers to observe and get the situation before speaking. When he’s not working, he likes clubbing and going to parties with other University students.

[From Casting Call]
